title: Harness evaluation from real sessions: the morning a permanent case, every change through the suite
request: Every role and the coordinator measured on the conversation suite and on replays of recorded sessions; each failure a regression case; a gate fixed before each run; traces graded step by step. Done when the owner's morning is a permanent regression case, and a change to a prompt, a model or a gate runs the suite before it is on.
spec: Regression cases with expected traces, accepted sessions replayed on invented tables, the dev journeys, a step grader, stored runs with fingerprints and the models used, and the gates where a change goes live.
plan: Survey the session record, the signals, the morning and the existing gates.
Make each play record its own session and grade it step by step.
Write the morning's cases and the replay of accepted sessions.
Gate prompts and gates by fingerprint, models at the switch, decision models on their measurement.
Review, plant faults, fix, run and store.

decisions.decision: The morning is graded on its exact trace.
decisions.why: A permanent case must notice an extra question or a step out of place.

decisions.decision: A session case is replayed on a table invented from its data card.
decisions.why: A session keeps no rows; the card keeps its columns, bands and traps.

decisions.decision: Only a live run measures a prompt.
decisions.why: A run without a model sends none.

decisions.decision: A contradiction may pass the question cap, once.
decisions.why: A blocked build with no question left only stops.

change: dclab_rnd/agent_eval/regression (new), agent_eval/journeys (session record, advisor, data-card cases, live), datasets.py and dclab_core/datasets.py (answers), models/routing.py, ledger/routing.py, dclab_core/meet.py, card.py (dclab-core 0.33.0), draft/chat.py, scripts/affected_tests.py, Makefile; tests/test_harness_suite.py and test_harness_gate.py (new), test_decision_routing.py, test_model_management.py, test_shadow_mode.py, test_pages_platform.py, test_draft_flow.py, test_journeys.py; the plan, the roadmap, CLAUDE.md.

findings.defect: Anomaly said beside a file of known cases was never asked.
findings.scenario: The morning's other half: it is anomaly detection answered as the outcome, a file of found cases joined; the card kept anomaly while the project was built as a rare event.
findings.cause: No meet rule compared a stated anomaly with labels that are here.
findings.fix: The meet check asks it, blocking while the family was stated; the answer that known cases exist makes it a rare event.

findings.defect: A contradiction could not be asked once five questions were asked.
findings.scenario: The coordinator stopped at the meet check with no question pending.
findings.cause: Home's cap applied to every question.
findings.fix: A contradiction between the words and the data is asked past the cap, once.

findings.defect: The cases we found was not read as known cases.
findings.scenario: The person's labels answer left the labels unknown.
findings.cause: The label words had no such phrasing.
findings.fix: The phrase reads as a file of cases, tried after a column.

findings.defect: A stream test raced under load.
findings.scenario: On PostgreSQL in the milestone gate the chat event came after the analysis event and the test stopped reading.
findings.fix: It reads until it has seen both.

findings.defect: A route test built its project in a file store beside the server's.
findings.scenario: On PostgreSQL the server answered project not found.
findings.cause: The test made its own store.
findings.fix: It builds in the server's store.

findings.defect: No model could ever pass the suite.
findings.scenario: Every purpose was recorded as no model, so a reviewer could never move a purpose to one.
findings.cause: The served models were read through a module that has no such function, and the error was swallowed.
findings.fix: A run records the model that answered each purpose its plays asked, from their own session records.

findings.defect: In a live run the roles never asked a model and the spend was not capped.
findings.scenario: The coordinator ran in a private scope, and the Home agent's client had no limit.
findings.cause: The scope that keeps replicas off models was kept in a live run.
findings.fix: A live run drops the scope, splits one cap between the Home agent and the roles, and records the spend.

findings.defect: A prompt change passed by a run that never sends a prompt.
findings.scenario: Editing a role prompt and running the suite without models made the gate green.
findings.fix: Prompts are measured only by a live run; the ones changed since the latest live run are listed.

findings.defect: The cases and several gates were not fingerprinted.
findings.scenario: Weakening the morning's expectations left the gate green.
findings.fix: The cases, the dev journeys and every suite's gate are fingerprinted.

findings.defect: A prompt-only change skipped the harness gate in a package gate.
findings.scenario: Editing a prompt file selected no test naming it.
findings.cause: The affected-tests selection works by name.
findings.fix: The harness gate runs in every package gate.

findings.defect: A model set in the environment was not gated.
findings.scenario: Changing a tier's own model served it without a run.
findings.fix: Said in the status: a tier's own model is the owner's configuration.

findings.defect: The step grading accepted wrong traces.
findings.scenario: An extra question or a build tried before the analysis passed the morning.
findings.cause: Expectations were read as ordered subsequences.
findings.fix: An exact expectation per case, used by the morning, and no build before the analysis anywhere.

findings.defect: A confirmed anomaly beside a label file blocked for ever.
findings.scenario: After the person said nothing is labelled the mismatch still blocked and was never asked again.
findings.cause: The new rule ignored the answer.
findings.fix: Once the person says nothing is labelled it no longer blocks.

findings.defect: A labels answer naming a column was read as a file.
findings.scenario: The label column holds the cases we confirmed read as a file and asked for a missing file.
findings.cause: The new phrase was tried before the column words.

findings.defect: A replayed session lost its label file.
findings.scenario: A session with a labels table was replayed with one table.
findings.cause: The synthesized labels table went with the related tables.
findings.fix: It is replayed as the person's own label file.

findings.defect: A workspace's column names could reach a committed result.
findings.scenario: A session case's check details listed its card's columns.
findings.fix: A session's rows keep only the steps and whether they held.

findings.defect: Runs sorted as text, and an old measurement counted.
findings.scenario: A thousandth run would sort before the nine hundred ninety ninth; a decision measured on other journeys still let a model act.
findings.cause: Text sort; no check of the journeys measured.
findings.fix: Runs sort by number; a measurement counts only on the journeys of now.

measurements.name: the harness suite
measurements.gate: harness_gate_v1: every regression case and every accepted session case right on each step check and part, every dev journey right, no failure flag back
measurements.result: 17 of 17 right on every step and part, no model served, spent 0
limits: Two written cases and 15 dev journeys; no accepted session yet.
No live run: the prompts are not measured.

measurements.name: planted faults
measurements.gate: each planted fault fails a test

outcome: The owner's morning and its other half are permanent cases graded on their exact trace; accepted sessions replay on invented tables; no prompt, gate, model or decision model goes live before the suite passed on it.
lessons: A gate whose evidence can never be produced is a gate only an override passes: test the path that produces it.
A run that sends no prompt cannot vouch for one.
An ordered subsequence lets an extra step through: a permanent case needs its exact trace.
risks: A tier's own model set in the environment is outside the gates.
